mapper.select: SELECT * FROM normal_account ORDER BY account_id DESC

SELECT account_id, company_name, group_code, financial_institution, account_number, account_alias, account_type, currency_code, balance, status, start_date, end_date, created_at, updated_at FROM normal_account WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO normal_account ( company_name, group_code, financial_institution, account_number, account_alias, account_type, currency_code, balance, status, start_date, end_date ) VALUES ( #{companyName}, #{groupCode}, #{financialInstitution}, #{accountNumber}, #{accountAlias}, #{accountType}, #{currencyCode}, #{balance}, #{status}, #{startDate}, #{endDate} )
